Rain beads on the iron gate of a walled yard. A warden in a leather hood watches the road from under a lean-to, one hand on a cudgel.

::: gm
The warden is Bel. She is tired and wary, and lets travellers in for a coin or a good reason.

The yard beyond the gate holds nothing worth a roll: it is only the way on.
